title: Lifestyle
slide_intent: Direct a food scene around an action or exchange. A gesture gives the viewer a way into the meal.
strategic_value: Instacart can connect grocery shopping with the pleasure of eating together by showing ingredients and people in the same moment.
demonstration: A shopping bag, a person tasting food, a kiss and a laughing diner share a collage with a family at a table. A dark green column calls for rich color, texture and candid action.
practical_value: Choose a frame in which the gesture and appetizing food both read. Use the four direction words as criteria when comparing candidate shots.

content_islands.name: Art direction
content_islands.spec: Set the title and short brief high on the dark left panel. Stack Active, Lush, Passionate and Candid near its foot.

content_islands.name: Lifestyle collage
content_islands.spec: Tile the photographs edge to edge at right. Let the laughing diner occupy a wider panel below the smaller preparation and tasting scenes, with the paired portrait and table scene at far right.
